description: This file defines the MathIllegalNumberException class, which serves as a base class for exceptions related to invalid numeric arguments within the Apache Commons Math3 library. It extends MathIllegalArgumentException and introduces specific handling for numeric arguments, including storing the invalid number and providing access to it.

classes.name: MathIllegalNumberException
classes.description: Base class for exceptions thrown due to invalid numeric arguments in the Apache Commons Math3 library. It extends MathIllegalArgumentException and includes a field to hold the offending argument.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Returns the invalid number argument that caused the exception.
